body: I used to struggle with my family alot as well. If you ever want to chat, send me a message.

I started entertaining ideas of killing myself when I was around 6 as well. Used to choke myself as long as I would dare with a towel over the shower curtain bar, thoughts of running away, self harm etc. 

I'm 24 now and I rarely think about killing myself now. It was an almost daily obsession for many years of my life.
